name: Vaillancourt Fountain
note: Justin Herman Plaza, brutalist square-tube concrete tangle over a basin. Not models — built as a fountain (MODELS_NEEDED.md).

name: Lotta's Fountain
note: Market/Kearny/Geary, cast-iron column with lion-head spouts over a basin, the oldest monument in the city.

name: Cupid's Span
note: Rincon Park, giant bow and part-buried arrow (Oldenburg/van Bruggen 2002).

name: Ruth Asawa Mermaid Fountain
note: Ghirardelli Square: basin only, figures coming from the owner. Round stepped basin and a central plinth for the hand-modelled mermaid group.

name: Redwood Park pool
note: Transamerica Redwood Park: basin only, figures coming from the owner. Small granite-rimmed pool and nearby puddle discs for the hand-modelled frog and Puddle Jumpers children.

name: MLK Memorial Waterfall
note: Yerba Buena Gardens, wide granite waterfall wall, walkable behind.

name: Hearts in San Francisco (Union Square)
note: ONE heart model, several placements round the city; recolour per instance.

name: Hearts in San Francisco (Ferry Building)
note: second placement of the same heart model.

name: Language of the Birds
note: Broadway and Columbus, translucent books suspended on poles over the pavement.

name: Francis Scott Key Monument canopy
note: Golden Gate Park: the stone canopy only — the figure is a real model placed separately.

name: Robert Louis Stevenson Memorial
note: Portsmouth Square, granite shaft with a small bronze galleon on top.
